claims.quote: The research model now puts every run's ideas in one order. The rules that ordered the formal-verification ideas moved into the shared frame, and new rules say which ideas are left to build, which can start now and which wait for another, which would change a rule Lion documents, and why each other idea was passed over. Its page, `research/runs/consolidation/`, ranks first a solver for the values a question leaves open, which would change the rule that every variable in a filter must first be bound, so it waits for a decision. Every program earlier runs kept was run again on Lion as it is now: an aggregated relation now takes facts, and a condition must be true or false, so one program now asks `value/number?`.
